method: Primary-source desk research and actual ADC code/evidence inspection. No clinic interviews, competitor execution tests or patient data access.

sources.title: Open Dental Quick Manual
sources.read_scope: Index and organizing modules
sources.limitations: Abridged manual; no performance or clinical qualification claim.

sources.title: Open Dental appointments
sources.read_scope: Day/week calendar and outstanding scheduling work
sources.limitations: Documented behavior only; no measured benefit.

sources.title: Open Dental family
sources.read_scope: Family, guarantor, contact and recall information
sources.limitations: US family/guarantor concepts do not establish guardian or clinical consent authority.

sources.title: Open Dental treatment plan
sources.read_scope: Versions, priorities, estimates and planned appointments
sources.limitations: Acceptance and estimates are distinct from actual treatment.

sources.title: Open Dental chart
sources.read_scope: Dental history, charting, consent, lab and related clinical work
sources.limitations: Feature overview; not a reviewed Chinese clinical template.

sources.title: Open Dental account
sources.read_scope: Ledger and patient/family financial workflow
sources.limitations: US billing/insurance assumptions require local adaptation.

sources.title: Open Dental patient payment
sources.read_scope: Procedure allocations and family payment behavior
sources.limitations: No real payment provider verification performed.

sources.title: Open Dental recall list
sources.read_scope: Due patients, communication status and scheduling
sources.limitations: No evidence that reminders alone improve attendance.

sources.title: Open Dental lab cases
sources.read_scope: Supplier, due date, dispatch/return and appointment coordination
sources.limitations: Workflow reference; no supplier integration tested.

sources.title: Open Dental imaging
sources.read_scope: Patient images, import, viewing and retained originals
sources.limitations: No device or image interoperability acceptance.

sources.title: Open Dental management
sources.read_scope: Tasks, inventory, accounting and backup organization
sources.limitations: Index-level scope, not a feature completeness audit.

sources.title: Open Dental supply inventory
sources.read_scope: Suppliers, orders, receipt and equipment inventory
sources.limitations: Does not establish comprehensive lot or sterile-package traceability.

sources.title: Dentrix Ascend treatment-plan case
sources.read_scope: Cases organized into visits and statuses
sources.limitations: Documented product workflow only.

sources.title: Dentrix Ascend recare
sources.read_scope: Continuing-care intervals and worklists
sources.limitations: Index and linked-topic scope; no customer outcome measurements.

sources.title: Dentrix Ascend signed-note addendum
sources.read_scope: Preserved signed content and attributed additions
sources.limitations: Not evidence of compliance with another jurisdiction.

sources.title: Dentally patient medical history
sources.read_scope: Reported/signed history, professional review and retained old history
sources.limitations: Product-specific 24-hour edit policy is not adopted as a Chinese legal rule.

sources.title: CareStack patient search scope
sources.read_scope: Location-scoped search and documented duplicate/portal trade-offs
sources.limitations: No justification for unrestricted chain-wide chart access; displayed update 2026-09-07.

sources.title: CareStack recall management
sources.read_scope: Advertised recall intervals, communication and outcomes
sources.limitations: Marketing reach/efficiency claims excluded.

sources.title: CareStack groups and DSOs
sources.read_scope: Advertised centralized configuration and multi-site workflows
sources.limitations: No measured scale, security or adoption inferred.

sources.title: 领健 e看牙 official scope
sources.read_scope: Advertised domestic clinical, CRM, inventory, imaging, BI and chain scope
sources.limitations: Customer counts and comparative claims excluded.

sources.title: 牙医管家 developer product description
sources.read_scope: Developer description of appointment, follow-up, record, payment and inventory scope
sources.limitations: Developer claims establish advertised scope only; adoption claims excluded.

sources.title: ADA State of the US Dental Economy Q3 2026
sources.read_scope: Operating constraints and methodology; 750 respondents, including 704 private-practice dentists
sources.limitations: US selected panel with documented response/composition limits; not a China prevalence estimate; no chart-derived percentage used.

sources.title: 2022 clinic filing measures and publication of basic standards
sources.read_scope: Full main notice/measures; service scope, staff, equipment, infection control and regulatory reporting
sources.limitations: 2022 basic-standards attachment inaccessible; no chair ratios or unread attachment clauses asserted.

sources.title: 2025 electronic medical record access notice
sources.read_scope: Full notice on purpose/task/time-limited access, identity, traceability, export and supplier controls
sources.limitations: Clinic-specific implementation and local applicability require review; no certification asserted.

sources.title: 2017 electronic medical record application norm
sources.read_scope: Full norm on record identity, changes, archive and retention
sources.limitations: Outpatient retention rule refers to institution-kept records; scope and current local implementation need review.

sources.title: 2018 prescription-review norm
sources.read_scope: Full norm including Article 3 applicability and review before pricing/charge/dispense
sources.limitations: Article 3 distinguishes mandatory institutional categories from other institutions referring to the norm; do not universalize that distinction.

sources.title: Personal Information Protection Law
sources.read_scope: Lawful bases, sensitive health/child data, processor duties and safeguards
sources.limitations: Consent is not the only lawful basis; under-14 data protection is not a universal medical-consent age.

sources.title: CDC sterilization and disinfection
sources.read_scope: Packaging/load records, process monitoring and response to failure
sources.limitations: International workflow reference, not a Chinese legal requirement or actual clinic audit.

sources.title: WS 506-2016 publication entry
sources.read_scope: Official search-visible title/publication/effective-date entry only
sources.limitations: Direct page returned 412; full standard not read or clause-audited. Do not use as support for detailed sterilization requirements.

sources.title: HL7 FHIR R4 RelatedPerson
sources.read_scope: R4 relationship, contact and actor vocabulary
sources.limitations: Vocabulary reference only; not the latest-version claim, a prescribed schema or FHIR conformance.

sources.title: HL7 FHIR R4 Encounter
sources.read_scope: R4 actual interaction versus scheduling and encounter granularity
sources.limitations: No FHIR interface implemented or accepted.

sources.title: DICOM PS3.1 2024d introduction
sources.read_scope: Introduction text surfaced through search; standards vocabulary
sources.limitations: No complete normative-series audit or current-version assertion; use actual partner conformance documentation for integration.

sources.title: OWASP ASVS official project
sources.read_scope: Stable 5.0.0 and versioned requirement structure
sources.limitations: No completed ADC ASVS assessment or certification.

sources.title: Google SRE implementing SLOs
sources.read_scope: User-visible objectives and evidence-based reliability priorities
sources.limitations: No ADC SLA or measured target-environment availability established by the reference.

provided_course_sources.use: Requirements versus design; testable observable behavior; invariants and failure responses. Read-only supplied reference, not redistributed.
Separation, restricted visibility, simplicity and information hiding. Read-only supplied reference, not redistributed.

excluded_evidence: Vendor market-share and outcome claims were not independently verified and are not used as prevalence or effectiveness evidence.
An unrelated-link-contaminated help-site index was not used for business claims; the developer product listing was used instead.
No unread standards attachment or search-only detailed clause is presented as an inspected legal requirement.
